name: universal-research-memory
description: A standalone, source-grounded research memory MCP and governed operating framework.

interface.shortDescription: Retrieve research evidence with approval and provenance controls.
interface.longDescription: Universal Research Memory provides independent, source-grounded research retrieval plus explicit approval, provenance, uncertainty, and audit boundaries without sharing a project's runtime database.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the research workflow: search candidates first, verify source lines for material claims, preserve uncertainty, and do not make unapproved changes.
